study_scope: Cao as reproduced by Ni, Table 1.1 p. 17 row 1. Xu et al., Table 1, explicitly include Shanghai in their Jiangsu definition for 1893. The Shanghai International Settlement enlarged in 1899 (Shanghai Municipal Council 1899 report and US FRUS 1899 document 233). The treatment of settlement residents in Cao is unquantified. Neither treaty-port population is added to the province. The 1911 CHGIS comparison feature is 195001; no opening polygon is assigned.

Correct the WWO name reference: 江西省 is label 7. Cao estimate on the existing Jiangxi statistical scope, with historical prefectures and Ningdu. Wuyuan then belonged to Anhui. The 1911 comparison feature is 195010. Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 3.

Cao as reproduced by Ni, Table 1.1 p. 17 row 2. The gazetteer lists 11 prefectures and Dinghai directly administered subprefecture. Ningbo is a contained treaty port; the adopted estimate does not itemize the foreign settlement or identify island residents separately. No independent settlement total or 1900 polygon is assigned.

Correct the WWO name reference: 贵州省 is label 18. Cao estimate on the existing Guizhou statistical scope, separate from Yunnan, Guangxi, Hunan and Sichuan. The 1911 comparison feature is 195018. Ni Table 1.1 p. 17 row 16.
